pages.text: Smelt your first Steel — Thermal is the Tier 2 tech mod, and Steel is the T2 baseline the Engineering lane runs on.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Steel is the T2 baseline material. Thermal Smeltery produces Steel Ingots efficiently. The Series covers Energy, Dynamics (pipes/ducts), and Cultivation (farming machines).$(br2)$(bold)Ore processing:$() Tier 2 marks the start of ore doubling and tripling. A Thermal Smeltery + Pulverizer setup yields 2–3 ingots per ore.

$(bold)Material relevance:$() Signalum, Lumium, and Enderium are Tier 2–3 Thermal alloys. Enderium is a T3 material in this pack.$(br2)$(bold)Artificer synergy:$() Efficient Engineering passive boosts all Thermal machine speeds. A T2 Artificer with good Skill investment is significantly ahead on material production.

$(bold)No book needed.$() Thermal Series is fully documented in JEI — every machine recipe, augment slot, and component is listed.$(br2)$(bold)Next: build a Pulverizer + Redstone Furnace pair and start doubling ore — $(l:icraft:engineering/t2_infrastructure)T2: Infrastructure$(/l) walks the build order.$()
